test_cases.test_name: Verify Continuous Temperature Monitoring and Data Recording Intervals
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System continuously monitors temperature in GMP storage areas and records data at intervals not exceeding 5 minutes.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all designated GMP storage areas.
System access credentials are available.

test_steps.action: Log in to the EMS software using valid credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: User is successfully logged into the EMS application.

test_steps.action: Navigate to the real-time monitoring dashboard for a selected GMP storage area.
test_steps.expected_result: Real-time temperature readings for the selected area are displayed.

test_steps.action: Observe the temperature readings for a period of at least 10 minutes, noting the timestamps of each recorded reading.
test_steps.expected_result: Temperature readings are continuously updated and recorded with timestamps.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of each recorded temperature reading
Recorded temperature value at each timestamp

test_steps.action: Calculate the time difference between consecutive recorded temperature readings.
test_steps.expected_result: The time difference between any two consecutive readings does not exceed 5 minutes.

acceptance_criteria: The EMS software successfully logs in.
Real-time temperature data is displayed for the selected GMP storage area.
Temperature readings are recorded continuously.
The interval between consecutive recorded temperature readings is consistently 5 minutes or less.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be accurate and complete.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Temperature Range, Accuracy, and Alarm Generation
test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS operates within the specified temperature range and accuracy, and generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are installed and calibrated in all designated GMP storage areas.
System access credentials are available.
A known temperature source (e.g., calibrated thermometer, environmental chamber) is available for testing.
Setpoint for alarm is defined and known.

test_steps.action: Log in to the EMS software using valid credentials.
test_steps.expected_result: User is successfully logged into the EMS application.

test_steps.action: Configure a GMP storage area to monitor a temperature within the specified range (-80°C to +50°C), for example, 20°C.
test_steps.expected_result: Configuration is successful, and the system is ready to monitor at the setpoint.

test_steps.action: Expose the temperature sensor in the configured area to a temperature that is within ±0.5°C of the setpoint (e.g., 20.2°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS displays a temperature reading within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature.

test_steps.action: Expose the temperature sensor to a temperature that deviates ±2°C from the setpoint (e.g., 22°C or 18°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alert notification for the temperature deviation.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification is received within 30 seconds of the deviation.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification is received within the specified response time.

test_steps.action: Return the temperature to within the acceptable range (e.g., 20°C).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS returns to normal monitoring status, and any active alarm is cleared or acknowledged.
data_to_capture: Timestamp of temperature return to normal

acceptance_criteria: The EMS successfully logs in.
Temperature readings displayed by the EMS are within ±0.5°C of the actual temperature within the specified range.
An alert is generated when the temperature deviates ±2°C from the setpoint.
Alarm notifications are received within 30 seconds of the deviation.
The system returns to normal monitoring status after the temperature is corrected.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarm events must be logged correctly with timestamps.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Vendor Software Unmodified and Data Storage Format
test_cases.objective: To verify that the vendor-supplied software is used without modification and that all data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
Access to system logs and database configuration.

test_steps.action: Review system installation and configuration files to confirm no custom modifications have been made to the vendor-supplied software.
test_steps.expected_result: System installation and configuration files show no evidence of unauthorized modifications to the vendor-supplied software.

test_steps.action: Access the EMS database and examine the structure and format of stored temperature and humidity data.
test_steps.expected_result: Stored data is in the vendor's standard database format, as documented by the vendor.

acceptance_criteria: The vendor-supplied software has not been modified.
All recorded data is stored in the vendor's standard database format.
data_integrity_requirements: Data must be stored in a verifiable and standard format.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Audit Trail and Electronic Signature Functionality
test_cases.objective: To verify that the system maintains an audit trail per 21 CFR Part 11 and utilizes vendor's built-in functionality for electronic signatures.
prerequisites: EMS system is installed and operational.
User accounts with appropriate permissions are created.
Access to audit trail logs and electronic signature features.

test_steps.action: Perform a system configuration change (e.g., adjust a setpoint) and verify that an entry is created in the audit trail detailing the user, date, time, and the change made.
test_steps.expected_result: A comprehensive audit trail entry is generated for the configuration change, including user, date, time, and specific modification.

test_steps.action: Initiate an action requiring an electronic signature (e.g., approving a report or acknowledging an alarm) and verify that the vendor's built-in electronic signature functionality is used.
test_steps.expected_result: The system prompts for and captures an electronic signature using the vendor's standard functionality, including user credentials and timestamp.

test_steps.action: Review the audit trail to confirm it meets the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11, including immutability and traceability.
test_steps.expected_result: The audit trail is complete, accurate, and tamper-evident, meeting the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11.

acceptance_criteria: The system generates a complete and accurate audit trail for all critical actions.
Electronic signatures are captured using the vendor's built-in functionality.
The audit trail meets the requirements of 21 CFR Part 11.
data_integrity_requirements: Audit trail must be complete, accurate, and tamper-evident.
Electronic signatures must be legally binding and verifiable.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Standard Report Usage and Data Archival
test_cases.objective: To verify that standard reports provided by the vendor are used for batch release and that data is retained for 7 years using the vendor's archival feature.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Sufficient historical data exists to test archival.
Access to vendor-provided standard reports.

test_steps.action: Generate a standard report for a specific batch release period using the vendor's built-in reporting functionality.
test_steps.expected_result: The system generates the requested standard report, displaying accurate temperature and humidity data for the specified period.

test_steps.action: Initiate the vendor's archival feature for data older than 7 years.
test_steps.expected_result: The system successfully archives data older than 7 years, and this data is no longer directly accessible in the active database but can be retrieved via the archival mechanism.
data_to_capture: Verification of data removal from active database

acceptance_criteria: Standard reports generated by the system are suitable for batch release purposes.
Data older than 7 years is successfully archived and retrievable.
The archival process does not impact the integrity or availability of current data.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Alarm Notification Integration with Paging System
test_cases.objective: To verify that alarm notifications generated by the EMS integrate correctly with the site paging system using the vendor API.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System (EMS) is installed and configured.
Site paging system is operational and configured to receive notifications.
Vendor API for alarm notifications is accessible and configured.

test_steps.action: Induce a temperature deviation that triggers an alarm condition (e.g., exceed ±2°C from setpoint).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification.

test_steps.action: Observe the site paging system for the incoming alarm notification.
test_steps.expected_result: The site paging system receives the alarm notification from the EMS via the vendor API within the specified response time.
data_to_capture: Time of notification received by paging system
Content of the notification on the paging system

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification on the paging system contains accurate information (e.g., location, severity, temperature reading).
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification on the paging system accurately reflects the details of the triggered alarm from the EMS.
data_to_capture: Comparison of EMS alarm details with paging system notification content

acceptance_criteria: Alarm notifications are successfully transmitted from the EMS to the site paging system.
Notifications are received within the system response time (URS-EMS-011).
The content of the alarm notification on the paging system is accurate and complete.

test_cases.test_name: Verify System Availability and Data Storage Capacity
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System meets the specified availability of 99.5% and has sufficient data storage capacity for at least 10 years of continuous monitoring.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and operational.
Access to system logs and monitoring tools.
Knowledge of system maintenance schedules.

test_steps.action: Monitor system uptime over a defined period (e.g., 30 days) and record any unplanned downtime.
test_steps.expected_result: Unplanned downtime does not exceed the allowable percentage to meet 99.5% availability.

test_steps.action: Review system configuration and database size. Estimate the remaining storage capacity based on current data growth rate.
test_steps.expected_result: The system's data storage capacity is projected to support a minimum of 10 years of continuous monitoring.

acceptance_criteria: System availability is >= 99.5% excluding planned maintenance.
Projected data storage capacity is sufficient for at least 10 years.
data_integrity_requirements: Accurate recording of system uptime and downtime.
Accurate estimation of data storage needs.

test_cases.test_name: Verify Facility Management System Integration and Alarm Notification API
test_cases.objective: To verify that the Environmental Monitoring System can successfully interface with the existing facility management system via standard protocols and that alarm notifications integrate with the site paging system using the vendor API.
prerequisites: Environmental Monitoring System is installed and operational.
Facility Management System is operational and accessible.
Site paging system is operational.
Vendor API documentation for alarm notifications.
Network connectivity between systems.

test_steps.action: Configure the EMS to send temperature and humidity data to the facility management system using the specified standard protocols.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS successfully transmits data to the facility management system, and the data is correctly received and displayed.
data_to_capture: Configuration settings for facility management system integration
Screenshots of data in facility management system

test_steps.action: Simulate a temperature alarm condition within the EMS that triggers an alert.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification that is successfully sent to the site paging system via the vendor API.
data_to_capture: Receipt confirmation from paging system (if available)

acceptance_criteria: Data is successfully exchanged between EMS and facility management system.
Alarm notifications are correctly sent to the site paging system via the vendor API.
data_integrity_requirements: Data integrity during transmission between systems.
Accurate and timely delivery of alarm notifications.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS accurately measures temperature within the specified range and meets the required accuracy.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are calibrated.
Access to system logs and configuration settings.

test_steps.action: Introduce a calibrated reference thermometer into a GMP storage area monitored by the EMS.
test_steps.expected_result: The reference thermometer reading is within ±0.5°C of the EMS reading for the same location.

test_steps.action: Expose a sensor to a known temperature within the -80°C to +50°C range (e.g., using a controlled environmental chamber or dry ice for low temperatures, and a heated chamber for high temperatures).
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS reading for the exposed sensor is within ±0.5°C of the known temperature.

acceptance_criteria: All temperature readings from the EMS are within ±0.5°C of the calibrated reference thermometer or known temperature.
The system demonstrates accuracy across the specified temperature range.
data_integrity_requirements: Temperature data is accurate and reliable.

test_cases.objective: To verify that the EMS generates alerts when temperature deviates from the setpoint by ±2°C and that these alerts are handled correctly.
prerequisites: EMS is installed and configured.
Temperature sensors are operational.
Alarm setpoints are configured.
Site paging system is operational and integrated.
Access to system logs and alarm history.

test_steps.action: Adjust the temperature in a monitored area to be 2°C above the defined setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification within 30 seconds, and the alarm is logged in the system.

test_steps.action: Adjust the temperature in a monitored area to be 2°C below the defined setpoint.
test_steps.expected_result: The EMS generates an alarm notification within 30 seconds, and the alarm is logged in the system.

test_steps.action: Verify that the alarm notification is received by the designated personnel via the site paging system.
test_steps.expected_result: The alarm notification is successfully delivered to the site paging system and received by the intended recipient.

acceptance_criteria: Alarms are generated within 30 seconds of temperature deviating ±2°C from the setpoint.
All generated alarms are logged with accurate details.
Alarm notifications are successfully transmitted to the site paging system.
data_integrity_requirements: Alarms are accurately generated and logged.
